# Key findings (auto-generated)

Data window: 2016-09-15 to 2018-08-29 · 96,478 delivered orders · 93,358 unique customers · gross order-item value 15,419,774 · AOV 159.83

| # | Finding | Evidence | Suggested action |
|---|---------|----------|------------------|
| 1 | Repeat-purchase rate | Only 3.0% of customers placed 2+ delivered orders | Focus on the second purchase: post-delivery offers, review-triggered coupons |
| 2 | Customer value concentration | Top 20% of customers = 53.5% of gross order-item value | Protect and grow the high-value segment (RFM 'Champions') |
| 3 | Category concentration (top 5 by value share) | health_beauty 9.2%, watches_gifts 8.2%, bed_bath_table 7.9%, sports_leisure 7.3%, computers_accessories 6.7% | Prioritise inventory and marketing on these categories |
| 4 | Geographic concentration (top 3 states) | SP 37.4%, RJ 13.3%, MG 11.8% | Expand logistics or seller supply in under-served states |
| 5 | Freight share of order value | Freight = 14.3% of gross order-item value | Test free-shipping thresholds and regional fulfilment |
| 6 | Late delivery vs customer satisfaction | 8.0% of orders late; avg review 2.57 (late) vs 4.29 (on time) | Improve delivery-time estimates and carrier SLAs |
| 7 | Seasonality and growth | Peak month 2017-11 (1,153,364); 2018 vs 2017 (same months) 143.4% | Plan campaigns and capacity around peak periods |

_All numbers are computed from the data in `data/raw`. Describe them as findings from that dataset only. Gross order-item value = price + freight for delivered orders._
